from random import Random


MASK = 0xFFFFFFFF


class Bench:
    def setup(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.reset_model()

    def reset_model(self):
        self.s = {
            "pr": 0, "avgt": 0, "zcrt": 0, "ctrl": 0, "cfg": 0x201,
            "threshold": 0, "flush": 0, "im": 0, "ic": 0, "gclk": 0,
            "ris": 0, "prescaler": 0, "sck": 0, "ws": 1, "bitctr": 0,
            "sync1": 0, "sync2": 0, "lastsck": 0, "lastws": 1,
            "sr": 0, "wd0": 0, "wd": 0, "lastwd": 0,
            "wpp": 0, "wnp": 0, "dpp": 0, "dnp": 0,
            "first": 0, "rdy": 0, "sample": 0,
            "rp": 0, "wp": 0, "level": 0, "full": 0, "empty": 1,
            "sumctr": 0, "sum": 0, "zcctr": 0, "prevsign": 0, "zcr": 0,
        }
        self.mem = [None] * 16

    def flags(self, s):
        avg = 0
        zcr = 0
        if s["ctrl"] & 4:
            shift = 6 if s["cfg"] & 0x400 else 5
            avg = int((s["sum"] >> shift) > s["avgt"])
        if s["ctrl"] & 8:
            zcr = int(s["zcr"] > s["zcrt"])
        above = int(s["level"] > s["threshold"] or s["full"])
        return (s["empty"] | (above << 1) | (s["full"] << 2) |
                (avg << 3) | (zcr << 4) | ((avg & zcr) << 5))

    def selected(self, s):
        lj = (s["cfg"] >> 3) & 1
        channel = 2 if lj == (1 - s["ws"]) else 1
        return bool(channel & (s["cfg"] & 3))

    def processed(self, s):
        size = (s["cfg"] >> 4) & 63
        sample = s["sample"]
        value = sample >> (32 - size) if 0 < size <= 32 else 0
        if (s["cfg"] & 4) and (sample & 0x80000000) and size < 32:
            value |= (MASK << size) & MASK
        return value & MASK

    def read_value(self, addr):
        s = self.s
        addr &= 0xFFFF
        if addr == 0:
            return self.mem[s["rp"]]
        regs = {
            0x0004: "pr", 0x0008: "avgt", 0x000C: "zcrt",
            0x0010: "ctrl", 0x0014: "cfg", 0xFE00: "level",
            0xFE04: "threshold", 0xFE08: "flush",
            0xFF00: "im", 0xFF04: "mis", 0xFF08: "ris",
            0xFF10: "gclk",
        }
        if addr == 0xFF04:
            return s["ris"] & s["im"]
        if addr in regs:
            return s[regs[addr]]
        return 0xDEADBEEF

    def advance(self):
        d = self.dut
        if int(d.PRESETn.value) == 0:
            self.reset_model()
            return

        o = self.s
        n = dict(o)
        addr = int(d.PADDR.value) & 0xFFFF
        data = int(d.PWDATA.value) & MASK
        access = int(d.PSEL.value) and int(d.PENABLE.value)
        write = access and int(d.PWRITE.value)
        read = access and not int(d.PWRITE.value) and addr == 0

        # Interrupt conditions and clears use their values before this edge.
        n["ris"] = ((o["ris"] | self.flags(o)) & ~o["ic"]) & 63
        n["ic"] = 0
        n["flush"] = 0

        # Synchronizer and generated clocks.
        n["sync1"] = int(d.sdi.value)
        n["sync2"] = o["sync1"]
        if o["ctrl"] & 1:
            if o["prescaler"] == 0:
                n["prescaler"] = o["pr"]
                n["sck"] = 1 - o["sck"]
                if o["sck"]:
                    n["bitctr"] = (o["bitctr"] + 1) & 31
                    if o["bitctr"] == 0:
                        n["ws"] = 1 - o["ws"]
            else:
                n["prescaler"] = (o["prescaler"] - 1) & 255

        # Receiver edge detection, pulses, shift register and sample.
        rise = o["sck"] and not o["lastsck"]
        fall = not o["sck"] and o["lastsck"]
        wpulse = o["wpp"] or o["wnp"]
        dpulse = o["dpp"] or o["dnp"]
        n["lastsck"] = o["sck"]
        n["lastws"] = o["ws"]
        n["wpp"] = int(o["ws"] and not o["lastws"])
        n["wnp"] = int(not o["ws"] and o["lastws"])
        if fall:
            n["wd0"] = o["ws"]
            n["wd"] = o["wd0"]
        n["lastwd"] = o["wd"]
        n["dpp"] = int(o["wd"] and not o["lastwd"])
        n["dnp"] = int(not o["wd"] and o["lastwd"])
        if rise:
            n["sr"] = ((o["sr"] << 1) | o["sync2"]) & MASK

        if pulse:
            n["sample"] = o["sr"]
        if wpulse or dpulse:
            n["first"] = 1

        selected = self.selected(o)
        valid = bool(o["rdy"] and selected)
        value = self.processed(o)
        request_write = valid and bool(o["ctrl"] & 2)
        accepted_write = request_write and not o["full"]

        # FIFO memory is not reset by a flush; after a flush, conservatively
        # stop predicting old, potentially unwritten memory locations.
        if o["flush"]:
            n["rp"] = 0
            n["wp"] = 0
            n["level"] = 0
            n["full"] = 0
            n["empty"] = 1

        else:

            elif read and not o["empty"]:

                n["full"] = 0

        if valid:

            n["sumctr"] = (o["sumctr"] + 1) & 63

            if (o["sumctr"] & avg_mask) == 0:
                n["sum"] = magnitude
            elif o["ctrl"] & 4:

        if write:

                0x0004: ("pr", 0xFF),
                0x0008: ("avgt", MASK),

                0x0010: ("ctrl", 15),
                0x0014: ("cfg", 0xFFF),
                0xFE04: ("threshold", 15),
                0xFE08: ("flush", 1),
                0xFF00: ("im", 63),
                0xFF0C: ("ic", 63),
                0xFF10: ("gclk", 1),
            }
            if addr in writable:
                name, mask = writable[addr]
                n[name] = data & mask

        self.s = n

    def check(self):
        d = self.dut
        s = self.s
        assert int(d.PREADY.value) == 1, "PREADY must always be high"

    await stream(b, 180, 0, rng)

    # Fill to full, test the wrapped level, drain, wrap pointers, and flush.
    await b.reset()
    await b.write(0xFF00, 0x3F)
    await b.write(0xFE04, 5)
    await b.write(20, (32 << 4) | 3)
    await b.write(16, 15)
    await stream(b, 1700, 0, rng)
    await b.probe(0xFE00)
    await b.probe(0xFF08)
    await stream(b, 1200, 1, rng)
    for unused in range(20):
        await b.read(0)
    await b.probe(0xFE00)
    await b.write(0xFE08, 1)
    await b.probe(0xFE00)
    await b.probe(0xFE08)

    # Simultaneous read and write on empty, followed by ordinary writes,
    # and simultaneous read and write while occupied.
    await stream(b, 1100, 2, rng)
    await b.probe(0xFE00)
    await stream(b, 650, 0, rng)
    await stream(b, 900, 4, rng)
    await stream(b, 300, 3, rng)
    await b.write(0xFE08, 1)

    # Exercise channel selection, justification, shifts at and beyond the
    # word width, sign extension, detector windows and enables.
    settings = [
        (0, 3, 0, 0, 0),
        (1, 1, 1, 0, 0),
        (8, 2, 1, 1, 1),
        (16, 3, 1, 0, 2),
        (24, 3, 0, 1, 3),
        (32, 3, 1, 0, 0),
        (33, 3, 1, 1, 1),
        (63, 3, 1, 0, 2),
        (32, 0, 0, 1, 3),
        (32, 1, 0, 1, 0),
        (32, 2, 1, 0, 3),
    ]
    for index, (size, channels, sign, lj, windows) in enumerate(settings):
        cfg = ((size << 4) | channels | (sign << 2) | (lj << 3) |
               ((windows & 1) << 10) | ((windows & 2) << 10))
        await b.write(20, cfg)
        await b.write(8, [0, 1, 0x1000, 0x7FFFFFFF][index % 4])
        await b.write(12, [0, 1, 3, 31][index % 4])
        await b.write(0xFE04, [0, 1, 7, 15][index % 4])
        await b.write(0xFF0C, 0x3F)
        await stream(b, 850, index % 5, rng)

    # Change detector enables without resetting their sample counters.
    await b.write(20, (32 << 4) | 3)
    await b.write(8, 0)
    await b.write(12, 0)
    await b.write(16, 3)
    await stream(b, 1000, 1, rng)
    await b.write(16, 15)
    await b.write(0xFF0C, 0x38)
    await stream(b, 2500, 1, rng)
    await b.write(16, 7)
    await stream(b, 300, 1, rng)
    await b.write(16, 11)
    await stream(b, 300, 1, rng)

    # GCLK must not stop the logic; finish by testing asynchronous reset
    # after the receiver, FIFO, interrupts and counters have been active.
    await b.write(0xFF10, 1)
    await stream(b, 400, 0, rng)
    await b.reset()
    for addr in [4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 0xFE00, 0xFE04, 0xFE08,
                 0xFF00, 0xFF04, 0xFF08, 0xFF10]:
        await b.probe(addr)
